name: Populated workspaces load their own balances without desktop mounting
Worklist includes older months, paginates, searches, and filters
Draft inputs survive user switching and do not leak into another user
Single entry saves once, appears in Entries, and edits without duplicating
Submission targets the selected period and refreshes the worklist status
Phone navigation remains responsive with 480 stored entry lines
Layout fits 320, 390 and 430 pixel phone widths
Double-entry switching retains values and validates the balanced pair
Failed fund loading shows a retry instead of an empty worklist
Reviewed report opens in the phone editor and Back returns safely
Staff login opens only permitted workspaces and hides administrative navigation
